description: Maps data values onto the block (0.9.9). The plotted area is the block minus Inset on every side

XMin.description: X range minimum. Defaults to the range of the data of the shape

XMax.description: X range maximum. Defaults to the range of the data of the shape

YMin.description: Y range minimum. Defaults to the range of the data of the shape

YMax.description: Y range maximum. Defaults to the range of the data of the shape

InvertY.description: If true, the smallest Y is at the top (e.g. position 1 on a lap chart). Defaults to false

Inset.description: Pixels between the block edge and the plotted area. Use the same value on stacked chart layers so that their scales line up

BandX.description: Category X axis: every whole value from min to max gets its own slot

BandY.description: Category Y axis: every whole value from min to max gets its own slot
